subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘CARRY’ is written as ‘DBSSZ’ and ‘DELAY’ is written as ‘EFMBZ’. How will ‘FAITH’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:** Each letter of the given words are increasing by 1.**

For, CARRY is written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27b2a0eb90ecf94accf6207065cf837e41646fe9ae7dfc7ae28f6484624cac89.png] 

For, DELAY is written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e30577f273bbd5e99bae4dc78ab3ab6f5e821326762134b9eacf64aa590d917.png] 

Similarly, FAITH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/451decafe52c8fe7733bfa7d1715918766606d8b3450227b51aff8dac95d7a3b.png] 

So, **FAITH** will be written as **GBJUI.**

Hence the correct answer is ***'Option 3'.***
